note: KNOWN critical/serious axe violations, keyed story|theme|rule. The build fails on any fingerprint NOT listed here (a new violation). Grow-only via `pnpm --filter @adminium/ui a11y --update-baseline`; remove a fixed entry by deleting its line. Harness errors are never listed. See scripts/a11y-sweep.mjs.
howToMeasure: Run it where the harness WAITS FOR THE STORY. scripts/a11y-sweep.mjs navigates with networkidle and .storybook/preview.tsx stamps data-vrt-ready on DOM quiescence; before both, the flag went up on mount while each widget family's lazily-imported body was still in flight, so the sweep scanned empty widget frames. This file is NOT platform-specific — an earlier revision of this note said it was, and that was wrong.

2026-08-18.whatTheNumbersDid: 162 -> 112. Three claims were made about this before the cause was understood, and the first two were wrong: 162 -> 1 (measured on a fast laptop that lost a race), then 162 -> 111 called LINUX-CANONICAL (measured on CI, which won the same race). The machines were never disagreeing about accessibility.
2026-08-18.theRace: data-vrt-ready was a bare mount effect. The widget registry loads component code through the definitions lazy refs, one Vite chunk per family, so the flag rose while the bodies were still loading. Measured on widgets-forms--light-ltr: 101 elements at the flag, 182 three seconds later. On widgets-tables-trackf--master-list-story: 30 vs 124. Whichever side of that a machine landed on decided its result, which also makes this the likeliest cause of the intermittent widget-render failures this repo has been re-running past.
2026-08-18.harnessDefect1: src/styles/storybook.css @source-d only packages/ui, while .storybook/main.ts has loaded the widgets and charts stories since 04-T17. Tailwind v4 generates utilities from source TEXT, so every widget and chart story rendered with class attributes and no rules behind them.
2026-08-18.harnessDefect2: Nothing painted --bg/--fg on the preview body, so Storybook white showed through and dark-theme foregrounds were measured against it. axe resolves color-contrast against the nearest opaque ancestor, so the translucent tone tints composited over white and reported pairs the product never renders.
2026-08-18.reconciliation: Against the original 162: 111 do not reproduce and were artifacts of the two defects above; 51 were real all along; 59 more were exposed once the stories rendered styled. 128 violations were found and FIXED rather than baselined - alpha-dimmed small text, six keyboard-unreachable scroll regions, role=row containers with no cell children, a dl with a p child, an aria-expanded row that should have been a button, and two dimmed surfaces that never said aria-disabled.
2026-08-18.stillOpen: 112 entries, dominated by scrollable-region-focusable, color-contrast and nested-interactive. None individually accepted yet; RELEASE-GATE.md keeps that row unchecked.

widgets-tables-datagrid--selection-and-b.what: A danger status Tag (bg-danger-soft text-danger) inside a SELECTED DataGrid row (bg-accent-soft) in dark theme. Measured 4.41:1 against 4.5:1.
widgets-tables-datagrid--selection-and-b.whyNotFixedHere: Both tints are translucent by design, so a tone chip on a selected row composites tone-soft over accent-soft over the surface. Across the dark palette - 8 accents x 4 surfaces x 4 tones - 44 pairs fail, from 4.50 down to 3.54 (black accent, --surface-3, danger). This story is simply the one that renders it.
widgets-tables-datagrid--selection-and-b.whatTheGateDoesNotSee: packages/tokens/scripts/contrast-check.mjs measures <tone> on <tone>-soft over each SURFACE and every one passes. It does not measure a soft tint over ANOTHER soft tint, which is what a selected row is.
widgets-tables-datagrid--selection-and-b.theDecisionItNeeds: Palette-wide, one of three: lower the dark soft-tint alpha (14% -> 12% clears it at 4.60, visibly changing every tinted chip in dark); make tone-soft opaque, removing the stacking and the adaptability with it; or stop washing selected rows behind chip-bearing cells. Whichever is chosen, the gate should gain the composition.
